info.title: Route_Map_Entry
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

action.description: There are three types, permit, deny, and any.

call.description:
Reference Resource: [Route_Map_Entry](#/Route_Map_Entry)
If call command is used, nextrm indicate which route map to goto. This is optional.

half_life.description: Amount of time (in minutes) that must elapse to reduce the penalty by one half.

max_suppress_time.description: The longest amount of time (in minutes) that a route can be suppressed.

reuse.description: If the penalty is less than the reuse limit, a suppressed route that is up will no longer be suppressed.

suppress.description: If the penalty is greater than the suppress limit, the route is suppressed.

description.description: Free form description of the filter, this is optional.

exitpolicy.description: Rather than normal exiting, route map can continue on processing next route map, or goto N route map and continue on processing. This is optional.

goto_target.description:
Reference Resource: [Route_Map_Entry](#/Route_Map_Entry)
If exitpolicy is goto, nextpref is the route map to jump to. This is optional.

match.description: The match rule for route map. Default is deny.

ipv4_next_hop_address.description: Matches routes based on next hop IPv4 address.

ipv6_next_hop.description: Matches routes based on next hop IPv6 address.

local_preference.description: Matches routes with the specific local preference value.

metric.description: Matches routes with the specific metric value.

origin.description: Matches BGP routes based on the origin of the specified route. The allowed values are below.  1. <mark>EGP</mark> - Indicates that the route is learned through EBGP. 1. <mark>IGP</mark> - Indicates that the route is learned through IBGP. 1. <mark>incomplete</mark> - Indicates that the origin of route is unknown. This occurs when a route is redistributed into BGP.

probability.description: Randomly match specified percentage of the routes.

route_type.description: Match the specified route type.  1. <mark>local</mark> - Locally generated Border Gateway Protocol (BGP) routes. 2. <mark>internal</mark> - Open Shortest Path First (OSPF) intra-area and interarea routes or Enhanced Interior Gateway Routing Protocol (EIGRP) internal routes. 3. <mark>external type-1</mark> - For OSPF, the external type-1 keyword matches only Type 1(OSPF) external routes. 4. <mark>external type-2</mark> - For OSPF, the external type-2 keyword matches only Type 2(EIGRP) external routes. 'evpn-type-1' : Ethernet Auto-discovery Route 'evpn-type-2' : MAC/IP Advertisement Route 'evpn-type-3' : Inclusive Multicast Ethernet Tag Route 'evpn-type-4' : Ethernet Segment Route 'evpn-type-5' : IP Prefix Route

source_protocol.description: Match the specified source protocol of the routes.  1. <mark>static</mark> - Indicates that the route's source is static route. 2. <mark>connected</mark> - Indicates that the route's source is connected interfaces. 3. <mark>ospf</mark> - Indicates that the route's source is OSPF protocol. 4. <mark>static</mark> - Indicates that the route's source is BGP protocol.

vni.description: Matches routes with the specific Virtual Network-ID value.

match_as_path.description:
Reference Resource: [BGP_ASPath_Filter](#/BGP_ASPath_Filter)
Match routes based on AS path. This is optional.

match_community_list.description:
Reference Resource: [BGP_Community_Filter](#/BGP_Community_Filter)
Maps the community list that should be matched to whether it should be matched exactly or based on the presence of any community from the list.

match_extcommunity_list.description:
Reference Resource: [BGP_Community_Filter](#/BGP_Community_Filter)
Extended community list name to be matched.

match_interface.description:
Reference Resource: [Port](#/Port)
Match the specified interface in the route's next hop.

match_ipv4_next_hop_prefix_list.description:
Reference Resource: [Prefix_List](#/Prefix_List)
Match IPv4 next hop routes based on Prefix list. This is optional.

match_ipv4_prefix_list.description:
Reference Resource: [Prefix_List](#/Prefix_List)
Match routes based on IPv4 prefix list. This is optional.

match_ipv4_route_source_prefix_list.description:
Reference Resource: [Prefix_List](#/Prefix_List)
Match IPv4 source routes based on Prefix list. This is optional.

match_ipv6_next_hop_prefix_list.description:
Reference Resource: [Prefix_List](#/Prefix_List)
Match IPv6 next hop routes based on Prefix list. This is optional.

match_ipv6_prefix_list.description:
Reference Resource: [Prefix_List](#/Prefix_List)
Match routes based on IPv6 prefix list. This is optional.

match_tag.description: Match the specified tags in the route.

preference.description:
Reference Resource: [Route_Map_Entry](#/Route_Map_Entry)
Route map entries keyed by preference value.

route_map_continue.description: Specifies the route-map entry's sequence number that will be executed next if the current entry's match clause is successful If the specified entry does not exist, route-map processing will be terminated at the current sequence number if its clause is matched. Note that the 'continue' sequence number must be higher than the current route-map sequence number for it to take effect. This is optional.

set.description: The set rule for route map.

aggregator_as.description: Sets the originating AS of an aggregated route. The value is the Autonomous System  number.

as_path_exclude.description: Excludes AS numbers from the AS path. The value is a comma delimited list of autonomous system numbers to be excluded for incoming routes.

as_path_prepend.description: Prepends AS numbers to the AS path. The value is a list of AS numbers separated by a space.

atomic-aggregate.description: If set to 'true', upstream routers will be notified that route is aggregated. Default is false.

community.description: Sets the community list of the route.The value is community list name.

evpn_router_mac.description: Sets the Router MAC in the EVPN updates. An example of usage is, if the next-hop of a EVPN route is modified then the relevant Router MAC is updated with this option.

extcommunity_rt.description: Sets the route target extended community of a BGP route. The value is the community attribute in the form AA:NN where AA can be either AS number or IP address and NN is the community identifier.

extcommunity_soo.description: Sets the site-of-origin extended community of a BGP route. The value is the community attribute in the form AA:NN where AA can be either AS number or IP address and NN is the community identifier.

ipv4_next_hop_address.description: Sets the IPv4 next hop IPv4 address.

ipv6_next_hop_global.description: + Sets the BGP-4 + global IPv6 next hop address. The value is the IPv6 address.

local_preference.description: Sets the BGP local preference and the local preference value of an IBGP route.

metric.description: Sets the metric which is used with BGP route advertisement.

metric_type.description: Set the specified metric type.  1. <mark>internal</mark> - Open Shortest Path First (OSPF) intra-area and interarea routes or Enhanced Interior Gateway Routing Protocol (EIGRP) internal routes. 2. <mark>external type-1</mark> - For OSPF, the external type-1 keyword matches only Type 1(OSPF) external routes. 3. <mark>external type-2</mark> - For OSPF, the external type-2 keyword matches only Type 2(EIGRP) external routes.

origin.description: Sets the origin attribute of a local BGP route. The allowed values are below.  1. <mark>EGP</mark> - Indicates that the route is learned through EBGP. 1. <mark>IGP</mark> - Indicates that the route is learned through IBGP. 1. <mark>incomplete</mark> - Indicates that the origin of route is unknown. This occurs when a route is redistributed into BGP.

weight.description: Sets the weight of a BGP route.

set_community_list_delete.description:
Reference Resource: [BGP_Community_Filter](#/BGP_Community_Filter)
Removes communities from the specified community list for BGP route advertisements.

set_tag.description: Set the specified tags in the route.

Match routes based on IPv6 prefix list. This is optional.

match_tag.description: Match the specified tags in the route.

preference.description:
Reference Resource: [Route_Map_Entry](#/Route_Map_Entry)
Route map entries keyed by preference value.

route_map_continue.description: Specifies the route-map entry's sequence number that will be executed next if the current entry's match clause is successful If the specified entry does not exist, route-map processing will be terminated at the current sequence number if its clause is matched. Note that the 'continue' sequence number must be higher than the current route-map sequence number for it to take effect. This is optional.

set.description: The set rule for route map.

aggregator_as.description: Sets the originating AS of an aggregated route. The value is the Autonomous System  number.

as_path_exclude.description: Excludes AS numbers from the AS path. The value is a comma delimited list of autonomous system numbers to be excluded for incoming routes.

as_path_prepend.description: Prepends AS numbers to the AS path. The value is a list of AS numbers separated by a space.

atomic-aggregate.description: If set to 'true', upstream routers will be notified that route is aggregated. Default is false.

community.description: Sets the community list of the route.The value is community list name.

evpn_router_mac.description: Sets the Router MAC in the EVPN updates. An example of usage is, if the next-hop of a EVPN route is modified then the relevant Router MAC is updated with this option.

extcommunity_rt.description: Sets the route target extended community of a BGP route. The value is the community attribute in the form AA:NN where AA can be either AS number or IP address and NN is the community identifier.

extcommunity_soo.description: Sets the site-of-origin extended community of a BGP route. The value is the community attribute in the form AA:NN where AA can be either AS number or IP address and NN is the community identifier.

ipv4_next_hop_address.description: Sets the IPv4 next hop IPv4 address.

ipv6_next_hop_global.description: + Sets the BGP-4 + global IPv6 next hop address. The value is the IPv6 address.

local_preference.description: Sets the BGP local preference and the local preference value of an IBGP route.

metric.description: Sets the metric which is used with BGP route advertisement.

metric_type.description: Set the specified metric type.  1. <mark>internal</mark> - Open Shortest Path First (OSPF) intra-area and interarea routes or Enhanced Interior Gateway Routing Protocol (EIGRP) internal routes. 2. <mark>external type-1</mark> - For OSPF, the external type-1 keyword matches only Type 1(OSPF) external routes. 3. <mark>external type-2</mark> - For OSPF, the external type-2 keyword matches only Type 2(EIGRP) external routes.

origin.description: Sets the origin attribute of a local BGP route. The allowed values are below.  1. <mark>EGP</mark> - Indicates that the route is learned through EBGP. 1. <mark>IGP</mark> - Indicates that the route is learned through IBGP. 1. <mark>incomplete</mark> - Indicates that the origin of route is unknown. This occurs when a route is redistributed into BGP.

weight.description: Sets the weight of a BGP route.

set_community_list_delete.description:
Reference Resource: [BGP_Community_Filter](#/BGP_Community_Filter)
Removes communities from the specified community list for BGP route advertisements.

set_tag.description: Set the specified tags in the route.

parameters.name: Route_Map.name

Name of the routemap.

parameters.name: Route_Map_Entry.preference
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [Route_Map_Entry](#/Route_Map_Entry)
Route map entries keyed by preference value.

action.description: There are three types, permit, deny, and any.

call.description:
Reference Resource: [Route_Map_Entry](#/Route_Map_Entry)
If call command is used, nextrm indicate which route map to goto. This is optional.

half_life.description: Amount of time (in minutes) that must elapse to reduce the penalty by one half.

max_suppress_time.description: The longest amount of time (in minutes) that a route can be suppressed.

reuse.description: If the penalty is less than the reuse limit, a suppressed route that is up will no longer be suppressed.

suppress.description: If the penalty is greater than the suppress limit, the route is suppressed.

description.description: Free form description of the filter, this is optional.

exitpolicy.description: Rather than normal exiting, route map can continue on processing next route map, or goto N route map and continue on processing. This is optional.

goto_target.description:
Reference Resource: [Route_Map_Entry](#/Route_Map_Entry)
If exitpolicy is goto, nextpref is the route map to jump to. This is optional.

match.description: The match rule for route map. Default is deny.

ipv4_next_hop_address.description: Matches routes based on next hop IPv4 address.

ipv6_next_hop.description: Matches routes based on next hop IPv6 address.

local_preference.description: Matches routes with the specific local preference value.

metric.description: Matches routes with the specific metric value.

origin.description: Matches BGP routes based on the origin of the specified route. The allowed values are below.  1. <mark>EGP</mark> - Indicates that the route is learned through EBGP. 1. <mark>IGP</mark> - Indicates that the route is learned through IBGP. 1. <mark>incomplete</mark> - Indicates that the origin of route is unknown. This occurs when a route is redistributed into BGP.

probability.description: Randomly match specified percentage of the routes.

route_type.description: Match the specified route type.  1. <mark>local</mark> - Locally generated Border Gateway Protocol (BGP) routes. 2. <mark>internal</mark> - Open Shortest Path First (OSPF) intra-area and interarea routes or Enhanced Interior Gateway Routing Protocol (EIGRP) internal routes. 3. <mark>external type-1</mark> - For OSPF, the external type-1 keyword matches only Type 1(OSPF) external routes. 4. <mark>external type-2</mark> - For OSPF, the external type-2 keyword matches only Type 2(EIGRP) external routes. 'evpn-type-1' : Ethernet Auto-discovery Route 'evpn-type-2' : MAC/IP Advertisement Route 'evpn-type-3' : Inclusive Multicast Ethernet Tag Route 'evpn-type-4' : Ethernet Segment Route 'evpn-type-5' : IP Prefix Route

source_protocol.description: Match the specified source protocol of the routes.  1. <mark>static</mark> - Indicates that the route's source is static route. 2. <mark>connected</mark> - Indicates that the route's source is connected interfaces. 3. <mark>ospf</mark> - Indicates that the route's source is OSPF protocol. 4. <mark>static</mark> - Indicates that the route's source is BGP protocol.

vni.description: Matches routes with the specific Virtual Network-ID value.

match_as_path.description:
Reference Resource: [BGP_ASPath_Filter](#/BGP_ASPath_Filter)
Match routes based on AS path. This is optional.

match_community_list.description:
Reference Resource: [BGP_Community_Filter](#/BGP_Community_Filter)
Maps the community list that should be matched to whether it should be matched exactly or based on the presence of any community from the list.

match_extcommunity_list.description:
Reference Resource: [BGP_Community_Filter](#/BGP_Community_Filter)
Extended community list name to be matched.

match_interface.description:
Reference Resource: [Port](#/Port)
Match the specified interface in the route's next hop.

match_ipv4_next_hop_prefix_list.description:
Reference Resource: [Prefix_List](#/Prefix_List)
Match IPv4 next hop routes based on Prefix list. This is optional.
